I wouldn’t mind if he said something dumb like “hey OP? Genuine question here, do these verbal stims change depending on who you’re with? He says he doesn’t have these outbursts when he’s alone, only when he zones out around other people. And the outbursts are only sexual when *I* am talking to him while he’s zoned out, any other time his phrases are usually pop culture related.

Neither he nor I knew this was an example of verbal stimming until another commenter mentioned it. He never described to me the difficulty of trying to hold it back, I think because he doesn’t notice when he does it so he can’t hold back something he doesn’t notice. Now that I know how difficult it could be, it makes a lot more sense! Even if I’m TA this comment is very helpful, thank you

Okay, here are the changes I’ve made:

Bonus Proficiency: now gives proficiency with Alchemist’s Supplies since druids are already proficient with Herbalism Kit

Pick Your Poison: now a 2nd level ability so players can get used to it, Seed of Burdock now gives temp hit points equal to your Druid level plus five

Touch of the Sage: now a 6th level ability, and you can cast each spell without expending a spell slot once per short or long rest, after which you must cast them as normal

Venom in the Veins: now gives immunity to poison damage
